test_title: PYST 43: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight teachers Jatin, Abhi, Gopal, Heena, Ishaa, Rohit, Kajal and Leela are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Abhi is second to the left of Heena. Rohit is third to the right of Heena. Gopal is second to the right of Jatin. Rohit is second to the left of Jatin. Kajal is third to the left of Ishaa. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Gopal?
solution:
Given: Eight teachers Jatin, Abhi, Gopal, Heena, Ishaa, Rohit, Kajal and Leela.

1) Abhi is second to the left of Heena.

2) Rohit is third to the right of Heena.

3) Gopal is second to the right of Jatin.

4) Rohit is second to the left of Jatin.

5) Kajal is third to the left of Ishaa.

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a0ef13b9e708ad3ebb9d5279f9584078f5e5c7e59ce5054cfdbe1dba8c17bcc.png] 

So, **Heena** is sitting to the immediate right of Gopal.

Hence, the correct anwer is** "Heena".**
